payload.comment:
Prior-art stage is well-structured and internally consistent. Six arxiv sources are properly retrieved with full metadata (source_id, snapshot_path, snapshot_sha256, retrieved_at all before the current UTC timestamp). Seven ideas are extracted, each correctly attributed to a source and marked as hypothesis_to_validate, which is the appropriate status at this stage. Two proposals (hflip_only_aug and compact_conv_token_transformer) are coherent and appropriately scoped for a prior-art brief.

Verification of the compact_conv_token_transformer geometry: 28→14 (stride-2 3×3 conv) → 7 (stride-2 3×3 conv) yields a 7×7×128 feature map, flattened to 49 tokens of dim 128, plus one [CLS] token = 50 tokens. Two transformer blocks with d_model=128 (4 heads × head_dim 32), FFN 128→256→128, pre-norm, residual. Rough parameter count ≈ 0.4 M, well under the stated 2 M cap. Input shape (batch, 28, 28, 3) matches the standard MedMNIST distribution. 9 output classes and ~90 K training samples are consistent with PathMNIST. test_metrics_used is false. No deterministic findings are present.

Minor observations (non-blocking):
1. Several evidence_quote fields are truncated (ending with '…'), which limits full verifiability of the cited claims against the source text. This is acceptable for a brief but should be resolved before any downstream stage relies on the exact wording.
2. The ghostnet_vgg_robustness idea extrapolates from quantization-robustness findings to generalization under class imbalance; the logical bridge is somewhat tenuous. It is correctly flagged as a hypothesis, so no action is needed, but the validation plan should explicitly test the imbalance hypothesis rather than assuming it follows from quantization stability.
3. The framework_training_efficiency idea is an engineering/infrastructure consideration rather than a model-research hypothesis. It is valid to include but should be clearly separated from architecture/representation hypotheses in any downstream prioritization.

No critical or warning-level issues detected. The stage is ready to proceed.
